transcript: Please find the uh salary range for forest wildlife researcher.
response:
In India, the salary range for a forest wildlife researcher, often referred to as a wildlife biologist, generally spans from four lakh rupees per annum to fifteen lakh rupees per annum. Entry-level positions typically offer an average annual salary of approximately two lakh fifty-one thousand three hundred rupees, with senior roles potentially reaching up to ten lakh rupees per month or twenty lakh rupees per year. The average annual gross salary for a wildlife biologist in India is about nine lakh seventeen thousand thirty-seven rupees.

In the United States, the average annual pay for a Wildlife Researcher is around one hundred thirteen thousand one hundred two dollars. Salaries commonly range from sixty-seven thousand dollars to one hundred fifty-four thousand dollars, with top earners potentially making up to one hundred sixty-four thousand dollars annually. The median annual wage for zoologists and wildlife biologists was seventy-two thousand eight hundred sixty dollars in May two thousand twenty-four.
